items.title: Editor could use invisible Canvas for hit detection
Run-Time Skeleton Manipulation / Mutator API
items.description:
It should be possible to manipulate the skeleton with ease, "from the outside."
You should be able to say: "on instance <instance-id>, find the group named <foo>, (or at this path: ...), and rotate it 30 degrees to the right."
Or translate it dX, dY, per it's parent's coordinate frame, ...
